meta.title: HR and payroll · Clafina
meta.description: Staff, rotas, attendance, leave, payroll and reviews in one place. Each payroll run posts to the books, and what is owed is ready to pay over.

hero.title: Your people, their time and their pay, in one place.
hero.lede: Records, rotas, attendance, leave and reviews sit with payroll. A run is calculated, approved and paid, and the cost goes to the books by itself.

jobs.title: Pay everyone correctly
jobs.body: Payroll runs from pay groups, grades and your own tax tables. PAYE and pension are paid over from the run.

jobs.title: Rotas and attendance

jobs.title: Leave and reviews
jobs.body: Requests follow your approval policy, balances carry over, and performance cycles keep goals and reviews together.

items.text: Staff, departments, teams, jobs, contracts, right to work, documents and exit.
Compliance records, such as medicals and licences, with their expiry dates.
Every member is staff and reads their own record.
People update their own details from their record.
Shifts, rotation plans that make the rota, and holidays.
Clock in and clock out against the shift, in your organisation's time zone, by each person in the app.
Leave entitlements with carry-over, requests by approval policy, and My leave.
Pay groups, grades, components and salary structures.
Tax tables by country and state that you enter, tax profiles with reliefs, and tables for non-residents.
Payroll runs that are calculated, approved, paid or voided, with printed payslips and My payslips.
Voiding a paid run, with how the money comes back.
Net pay recorded as paid out, once it leaves your account.
Employer contributions posted with each run.
PAYE and pension paid over from the run as payment requests.
Performance cycles, a goals board, and reviews that are self-assessed and rated.
A people dashboard, and an HR overview of contracts ending and leave.

connectsTitle: Connected to the rest of the business

connects.text: Payroll posts to the ledger, and what is owed becomes payment requests.
Cost rates and the timeclock feed project time.
Production rosters and skills come from HR.
A leaver's exit starts the return of what they hold.

faq.q: Does Clafina come with tax tables for my country?
faq.a: No. You enter your own tax tables, by country and state, with reliefs and tables for non-residents. Payroll then works from them.

faq.q: Can staff see their own payslips and leave?
faq.a: Yes. Every member is staff and reads their own record, with My payslips and My leave.

faq.q: Can I undo a payroll run that was already paid?
faq.a: Yes. You can void a paid run, and Clafina shows how the money comes back.
